visual_differentiation_axes: fast side-view rail corridor instead of fixed mining field
dual side hook cables crossing the playfield
station signal dashboard instead of rounded top score pills
coal black, rust red, signal green, steel gray, and amber ore palette
minecart speed silhouette rather than static hook or lunar salvage claw
right-side route distance meter with station stamps
forbidden_visual_reuse: do not reuse crystal cave brass claw or prism order rail
do not reuse lunar dashboard oxygen and battery gauges
do not reuse farm market shelves or ranch animal cards
do not reuse tower defense build pads, shields, or medieval badges
do not use a generic gold nugget hook icon
do not place large HUD panels over side hook corridors

ui_identity.layout_archetype: rail express dashboard with top signal bar, central scrolling track, right station route meter, and compact bottom garage controls
ui_identity.hud_composition: durability gauge, cargo value, cable heat, current lane, station target, route distance, and warning signal lamps
ui_identity.navigation_model: menu to chapter route map to gameplay to station result to garage upgrades, with pause and help overlays
ui_identity.palette_signature: coal black, iron gray, rust red, amber ore glow, signal green, safety yellow, and cream gauge text
ui_identity.material_language: riveted metal, worn rail signs, station lamps, hazard stripes, old gauge glass, chain hooks, and timber braces
ui_identity.typography_style: condensed industrial sans labels with uppercase English station codes and readable numeric gauges
ui_identity.primary_ui_pack: skin_post_apocalypse with rail signal dashboard tuning

reserved_edges: top 12 percent for signal bar and cargo gauges
right 12 percent for route distance meter
bottom 10 percent for compact upgrade or result controls outside gameplay
left and right hook corridors remain open during play
hud_anchor_zones: bottom result controls only outside active route
playfield_safety.frame_overlay_policy: decorative rails, rivets, and signal frames must stay outside active lanes and must never cover hook targets, switches, obstacles, or lane change warnings

unique_screen_motifs: chapter map as stamped rail tickets
garage upgrades as bolted cart plates
help overlay as switchyard signal diagram
forbidden_ui_elements: wide bottom command strip covering rails

icon_identity.subject: speeding minecart firing two side hooks, one grabbing amber ore and one pulling a red rail barricade
icon_identity.silhouette: diagonal minecart motion, crossed hook cables, rail track arc, ore sparkle, and torn barricade plank
icon_identity.composition: cart in lower center racing right, left hook cable reaches amber ore, right hook cable yanks a warning barricade, curved rail and tunnel glow behind
icon_identity.palette: coal black, steel gray, rust red, amber ore glow, signal green, safety yellow
icon_identity.background: dark mine tunnel badge with curved rails, sparks, and station signal lights
icon_identity.game_specific_motif: moving minecart dual side hooks and rail obstacle pulling
forbidden_icon_reuse: no static gold hook and nugget
no lunar oxygen canister or satellite panel
